items.title: Lamech
items.charge: Taking two wives, the first in scripture; killing a man and boasting of it; claiming seventy-sevenfold vengeance

items.title: Moses, and the Egyptian in the sand
items.charge: Slaying the Egyptian that smote his brother, and hiding him in the sand

items.title: The old prophet of Beth-el
items.charge: Lying in the name of the Lord, claiming an angel’s word, to turn a prophet from his charge
